title: Watch Party Attendance vs Race Quality
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=race:watchparty guest_count=*) OR (index=personal sourcetype=ergast:result)
| bin _time span=1w
| stats max(guest_count) as guests, sum(eval(if(sourcetype="ergast:result",1,0))) as races by _time
| where races>0
| sort - guests
description: Correlates race-weekend watch-party guest counts with Ergast result events on the same calendar week.
value: Guest spikes on boring weekends may mean social draw beats on-track action for your crew.
implementation: Log watch parties with `guest_count` and align weekly bins with Ergast race result timestamps.
visualization: Scatter plot of guest count by race week.
grandmaExplanation: It spots whether your watch parties get bigger on the most exciting race weekends.
